i.norm: Tests that {@link LineIterator#nextLine()} returns every line of a file, in order, when the iterator is created via {@link FileUtils#lineIterator(File)} (which uses the platform's default encoding).
Given: a file written with three known lines using the default encoding.
When: iterating over the file with a LineIterator.
Then: nextLine() yields each expected line in order, and nothing more.
Writes {@code lineCount} lines ("LINE 0", "LINE 1", ...) to the given file using the default encoding and returns them.
